milestones.title: Phase 1 (Week 2): Core Fundamentals & Environment Setup
milestones.description: Master baseline architecture and environment setup for Python, SQL required for Data Scientist.

tasks.title: Setup Environment & Master Python Core Concepts
tasks.instructions:
1. Review official Python documentation and configure local development workspace.
2. Complete beginner tutorials covering syntax, data flow, and idiomatic conventions.
3. Build a minimal standalone sandbox demonstrating working configuration.
tasks.practical_exercise: Create a reproducible CLI or starter project repository verifying your Python installation.
tasks.deliverable: Clean GitHub repository with README instructions and successful hello-world run.
tasks.completion_criteria: Application executes without errors and core concepts are documented in README.
tasks.target_role_requirement: Fundamental competency for Data Scientist roles.

milestones.title: Phase 2 (Week 4): Hands-On Application & Component Engineering
milestones.description: Build practical modules and integration workflows using SQL, Pandas.

tasks.title: Build Modular Component / Service in SQL
tasks.instructions:
1. Design an isolated micro-feature utilizing SQL.
2. Handle edge cases, parameter validation, and robust error recovery.
3. Write automated unit tests verifying component reliability.
tasks.practical_exercise: Implement a functional data processing or UI component utilizing SQL with automated test suite.
tasks.deliverable: Tested module with test results log and clean code documentation.
tasks.completion_criteria: All unit tests pass and code adheres to industry linting and typing standards.
tasks.target_role_requirement: Required for practical development on team codebases.

milestones.title: Phase 3 (Week 6): Full Capstone Portfolio Project
milestones.description: Synthesize Python, SQL, Pandas into an end-to-end, portfolio-ready project.

tasks.title: Architect & Build Full-Stack Capstone Project
tasks.instructions:
1. Plan an end-to-end application highlighting Python, SQL, Pandas.
2. Structure database schemas, backend endpoints, and interactive frontend.
3. Implement secure authentication, responsive layout, and robust data persistence.
tasks.practical_exercise: Develop an end-to-end web service or tool relevant to Infosys.
tasks.deliverable: Fully functional GitHub repository with architecture diagram and live demonstration.
tasks.completion_criteria: Working deployment or local demo video, complete README, and verified operational state.
tasks.target_role_requirement: Provides tangible project proof to replace uncorroborated resume claims.

milestones.title: Phase 4 (Week 8): Automated Testing, CI/CD & Evidence Verification
milestones.description: Add production infrastructure, automated CI pipelines, and public evidence to verify your capabilities.

tasks.milestone_title: Phase 4 (Week 8): Automated Testing, CI/CD & Evidence Verification
tasks.title: Deploy with CI/CD Workflow & Document Verification Proof
tasks.instructions:
1. Add Docker containerization (Dockerfile + docker-compose) for reproducible environments.
2. Configure GitHub Actions workflow running tests and linter automatically on pull requests.
3. Write a comprehensive README with badges, setup guides, and architectural decisions.
tasks.practical_exercise: Automate deployment and test verification in your capstone repository.
tasks.deliverable: Passing CI/CD pipeline on GitHub with status badge and public link.
tasks.completion_criteria: Green build status on GitHub Actions and public repository link added to candidate profile.
tasks.target_role_requirement: Directly satisfies interviewer requirements for production engineering readiness.
